answer: Under the kernel, identity is earned rather than claimed — no proof, no seat at the table. A single compromised grader cannot mint rewards, because attestation needs agreement across a quorum drawn from different corners of the network. The mirror raises the attack from bribing one peer to capturing a rotating majority, and the cost of that majority grows with the network. Hold the zenith steady and the economy stays honest, because a clone army is only cheap when identities are free.
